The '''Crimson Stars''' were a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. 

==History==

The Crimson Stars first traveled to the Unknown Regions as part of a large pirate gang, but following a disagreement over a [[Gender/Legends|female]], the band split into the Crimson Stars and the [[Ebon Strikers]], with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Vallkos]] taking control of the Crimson Stars and his brother, [[Mallikhan]], becoming the leader of the Ebon Strikers. The two pirate gangs feuded with each other and at one point, their dispute threatened to escalate into all-out war between them.<ref name="TUR" />

The Crimson Stars generally preyed upon [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] that passed through Unknown Regions and every few months, they dispatched a group of their ships to travel to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to purchase supplies and sell on any exotic goods that the Crimson Stars had captured. However, the Ebon Strikers occasionally raided the Crimson Star [[Flotilla/Legends|flotillas]] on their return journey from the Outer Rim.<ref name="TUR" />
